title: Card Chargebacks on Northloop Payments: Liability, Debit, Fee and Dispute
content:
## Chargeback terms

1. A card chargeback on an order is debited to the seller only when the order's liability party is the seller; a chargeback on an order Northloop is liable for is never debited.
2. A seller-liable chargeback is debited in full on the chargeback notice together with the plan's chargeback fee.
3. The seller may dispute a chargeback within the chargeback response days counted in calendar days from the chargeback debit date, at most the per-case dispute limit, by submitting evidence of delivery, signature, an earlier refund or item description.
4. ~~When the issuer decides for the seller, the debit is returned;~~ this clause is **no longer in force**; the debit returned on a won case is governed by the current won-chargeback debit return basis of Northloop Payments.
5. ~~The fee is returned too only when the plan returns the chargeback fee on a win.~~ This clause is **no longer in force**; the fee returned on a won case is governed by the current won-chargeback fee return basis of Northloop Payments.
6. ~~A chargeback on an order already refunded in full to the buyer is won on refund-already-issued evidence, so the seller never bears both the refund and the chargeback for the same order amount.~~ This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current won-chargeback debit return basis.
7. A chargeback debit is returned only when the seller's dispute on that case is won.
8. A dispute filed after the response window, or lost, books nothing further.

## Liability and debit (clauses 1 and 2)

| Liability party on the order | Chargeback debited to the seller | Chargeback fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| the seller | yes, in full, on the chargeback notice | yes, the plan's chargeback fee, with the debit |
| Northloop | never | no |

## Return of a chargeback debit (clause 7)

The return rests on the dispute status recorded on that same chargeback case in the system, not on the seller's account of the outcome: a debit is returned only on a case whose dispute is recorded as won. A case whose dispute was filed after the response window, or was lost, books nothing further.

## Dispute evidence (clause 3)

Accepted evidence: evidence of delivery, signature, an earlier refund, or item description. The response window is the plan's chargeback response days, counted in calendar days from the chargeback debit date, and a case accepts no more dispute submissions than the plan's per-case dispute limit.

*Hypothetical case.* A seller on Payments Weekly receives a chargeback on an order whose liability party is the seller: the order amount is debited in full on the notice, with the 20.00 USD plan chargeback fee. Had Northloop been the order's liability party, nothing would have been debited.

superseded_clauses: When the issuer decides for the seller, the debit is returned;
the fee is returned too only when chargeback_fee_refunded_on_win is true.
A chargeback on an order already refunded in full to the buyer is won on refund_already_issued evidence, so the seller never bears both the refund and the chargeback for the same order amount.
